item.title: DevOps Is Bullshit: Why One Programmer Doesn't Do It Anymore
item.description: What's the deal with DevOps? In 2015, I asked myself that question and came up with a tounge-in-cheek answer that provided some catharsis and really helped put my career into perspective. It was one of the most popular things I've ever done. I've preserved it here for posterity. The comment section is a riot.
